newsitem.title: UK: GEC extend gains as merger talk continues.
newsitem.headline: GEC extend gains as merger talk continues.

text.p: Shares in General Electric Co Plc jumped on Wednesday, extending recent gains, after talk of a merger with British Aerospace continued and positive analysts comments in the financial press fuelled the rise, dealers said.
GEC shares rose 5-1/2p to 359p by 0758 GMT, in volume of 2.8 million shares. British Aerospace shares climbed 18p to 1368p.

GEC retreated from its intra-day trading high of 366p as profit-takers took advantage of the fourth consecutive daily rise in the shares. GEC shares had fallen to 327p on June 5, their lowest level for almost 18 months.
British Aerospace shares also ran into profit-taking, having traded at 13.77 stg soon after the market opened.
